title: Owner browser check: Spotify stays playable past the hour and reconnects only for a dead grant (RF-216)
acceptance: On desktop Chrome with Spotify Premium, against a production build that includes RF-216: (1) leave Ritmo and Spotify unused for at least 65 minutes, then open a Spotify-only class: Music and Connections show Spotify Connected, Live preflight passes and Start class is audible within a few seconds with no Reconnect prompt; (2) run a class across the hour mark from the last Spotify use and confirm music keeps playing through it; (3) remove Ritmo in Spotify's account 'Manage apps', then Start a Spotify class: Ritmo asks to reconnect Spotify. Retryable failures (Spotify 5xx/429, network) are proved by tests only; they cannot be forced on production.
nextAction: RF-216 is deployed (main eaddb1da, Worker a12d0e73, 2026-11-12), and RF-218 too (2026-11-21, main 35b5e73; production is now main 1eed288, Worker 515bc8fb, since 2026-11-23), so the steps also check that RF-218 left refresh and Reconnect working. Owner: run the three steps on desktop Chrome with Spotify Premium and record the result here. Step 3 removes Ritmo from Spotify's Manage apps, so reconnect Spotify afterwards.

evidence.summary: Split from RF-216's acceptance because it needs a deploy first.
Deploy 2026-11-12: RF-216 live on Worker a12d0e73 (main eaddb1da). Deploy only; no Spotify playback checked.

RF-218 deployed 2026-11-21 (Worker ce938163, main d4eff3f; production is now main 35b5e73, Worker 1fa79a87). The three steps now also serve as a regression check of RF-216 after RF-218: refresh still works past the hour and a revoked grant still shows Reconnect. RF-218 itself (a token-endpoint 4xx other than invalid_grant reads as retryable) is proved by tests only; none of the steps triggers that 4xx.
